verified: Official American Samoa Election Office .gov pages and the embedded 2026 election calendar were captured
Local walk-in absentee voting at the Election Office is published; qualifying travel requires proof of travel
states.reason: The saved official public pages give the election office mailing address and a Tafuna location on a separate poll-worker page, but no extractable current facility-address list or district polling-station assignments. Do not substitute the mailing address for a voting site. The official-linked Facebook desktop page exposes only public page metadata to an unauthenticated read; mobile states this browser is unsupported. No login or challenge was submitted.
states.next: Acquire the Election Office's 2026 district polling-station public notice and link the Election Office physical address to its current absentee-voting notice. Source discovery remains open; no claim the government has not published the list.

states.reason: FEC and EAC link Guam Election Commission. Its root, 2026 general-election page, polling routes and early-voting route return HTTP 503 with upstream TLS CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED. The official DOA mirror is accessible but its July circular concerns the primary; it does not prove October general-election voting sites. TLS verification was kept enabled. A native search of the official Mayors Council found officer elections and an old self-determination event, with no results for voting. The Commission Facebook route returned an actual login page; it was not submitted.
states.next: Recover the GEC source through the supported runtime trust configuration, or obtain an official current general-election notice mirrored by the governor, legislature or a village mayor. General-election coverage remains open.

states.reason: The 15 source records comprise 12 election-day facility/village locations and three early-voting service entries; this is not a deduplicated physical-facility count. A combined Northern Islands entry naming Alamagan, Pagan and Agrigan has no individual facilities and is excluded. Precinct assignments, hours, separate general early-voting phase and two published points are retained.
gaps: Street numbers and Census coordinates where the publisher supplies only a village and facility
states.next: Production-copy publication/readback; continue acquiring the individual Northern Islands sites.
